items.title: Russia–Ukraine peace talks conclude in Abu Dhabi with prisoner exchange agreement but no breakthrough on territory
items.summary: The trilateral talks between Russia, Ukraine, and the United States, held in Abu Dhabi on November 10–11, have ended. The head of the Russian delegation, Vladimir Medinsky, said Russia and Ukraine had agreed to a prisoner exchange, and that the central topic of the talks was the European security system, on which the sides “found mutual understanding in some areas, but not in others.” As expected, there were no breakthroughs on the other topics. The question of territory…

ai.sum: Abu Dhabi talks between Russia, Ukraine and the US ended with an agreed prisoner exchange but no territorial breakthrough.

items.title: Baltic nations, Finland issue overnight drone warnings as Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes

Ukrainian military drones straying into the airspace of Finland and the Baltics this year have fuelled concern that the Ukraine war is spilling into NATO…
